verdict.rationale: Lago's marketing page explicitly promotes entitlements tied to plans and billing (lago-docs-12, lago-docs-27), and the product has a general API reference/OpenAPI schema (lago-docs-1, lago-probe-3) that could expose such checks, but no evidence pack item shows an actual entitlements API endpoint, response schema, or SDK method for checking a customer's entitlements at runtime. Missing for 10: dedicated API/SDK reference documentation for entitlement checks, example requests/responses, and any hands-on or community confirmation that this works in practice.
